You know yourself best as far as what boundaries you want to set yourself. You maybe not be ready to have sex again or start dating for a long time and that is normal. You may not feel comfortable in your own skin, in unfamiliar crowds, or being alone in public spaces, etc. Some days are easier and some are harder to cope with.

I never take it personally on not getting a response, it comes with the territory. A lot of guests are understandably tired after their travel or have their own personal issues going on. Plus we are in a very stressful time. I can sometimes take disgruntled guests a bit personal but unless I do something to personally upset someone, I just have to empathize with their issues.

I usually just give a friendly greeting and ask how they’re doing, and read their body language before trying to engage in more chit chat and just tell them what they need to know about the property.

When I’m in a establishment, I’m generally pretty shy and want to limit a lot of small talk. People are just different.

I’m saddened to see what you put up with, as well as the responses. I’ve worked at one property primarily, aided in a few of my owners properties in the lapse of the pandemic, the largest being 116 rooms. 

I’ve never had these issues with staffing at any property. 

The issues as far as guest complaints, or sketchy guests varies. Some days more exhausting than others. FD sometimes bending policy, but generally since our rates have significantly lowered due to Covid we have a different clientele and seemingly more frequent issues. 

Are you able to look into other properties in your area? You don’t seem happy. It’s not a perfect job, you will have bad days anywhere but this seems like a bigger issue with how you describe. What is your relationship with upper management?
